_source: Village boundaries for Latur district, loaded into TerraRisk/Kshetra from OpenStreetMap via scripts/fetch_latur_villages_osm.py. Centroids only. OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
_note: Used to name the village a field sits in, which decides the leave-one-village-out folds. Boundaries are approximate, so the nearest village is reported with its distance rather than asserted as containment.
